paragraphs.text:
You see strange, bird-like markings and some scribbled words in 
the Professor’s familiar hand. Three of the words seem paired with 
the symbols— old, heavens, cold. Make an INT roll: if successful, 
go to 124. Failing, return to 150. 
(150)
